verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਲਛਲ ਬੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਹੀ ਕਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: par dhan par tan par apavaadh baadh balachhal ba(n)ch parapa(n)ch hee kamaat hai ||

en.bdb: He who keeps his interest in other person's wife, wealth and who indulges in other's slander, trickery and cheating,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਗੋਬਧ ਬਧੂ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬੰਸ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mitr gur savaiaam dhroh kaam krodh lobh moh gobadh badhoo bisavaiaas ba(n)s bipr ghaat hai ||

en.bdb: He who betrays a friend, Guru and master, who is caught in the vices of lust, anger, greed and attachment, who kills cow, woman, cheats, betrays his family and murders Brahmin,

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਓਗ ਆਪਦਾ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਨ ਜਮ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rog sog hui biog aapadhaa dharidhr chhidhr janam maran jam lok bilalaat hai ||

en.bdb: Who is suffering due to various ailments and distresses, who is troubled, lazy and vice-ridden who is caught in the cycle of birth and death and is in the stranglehold of the angels of death,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਬਿਸਿਖ ਬਿਖਿਆਦੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੀਨ ਅਧਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਮ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: kirataghan bisikh bikhiaadhee koT dhokhee dheen adham asa(n)kh mam rom na pujaat hai ||521||

en.bdb: Who is ungrateful, venomous and user of arrow-like sharp words, who is miserable due to countless sins, vices or imperfections; such countless evil-doers cannot match even a hair of my sins. I am many time more evil than them.  (521)
